parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description: The code for the multicloud service.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceParams
parameters.description: The parameters for the data source. The value must be a JSON array.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceRemark
parameters.description: The remarks on the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

- wafApi: Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF) download API.

- ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the data management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: For assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: For assets in regions outside China.
